notes.title: Co-Op Mode is Coming!
notes.notes:
Hey Football Pitch Managers! 👋⚽

We’ve been listening closely to your feedback, and today we’re excited to share a major announcement: Co-op mode is officially coming to Football Pitch Simulator! 🎉

Soon, you’ll be able to manage your football complex together with your friends in real time. Work side by side to keep your pitches in top shape, serve your customers, stock your market, and expand your business — as a team!

Here’s what you can expect from the new co-op mode:

    👥 2 to 4 players can play together

    🛠️ Divide tasks: one player can clean while the other repairs the pitch

    🛒 Collaborate in managing the market, locker rooms, and other facilities

    🌐 Online play support (local network & internet)

Co-op mode is currently in development and will be part of one of our upcoming major updates. Gameplay footage and more details will be shared soon!

As always, your suggestions mean the world to us — this game grows with your input. 💬
